Version 0.87.0

### ✨ New

- Added custom conversation font sizes so chat content, Markdown, and terminals can better match your reading preferences.
- HTML attachments can now open directly in live previews; Lody asks for confirmation before connecting to a remote port reported by the Agent.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed an issue where starting a conversation through a mentioned Role could fail.
- Improved queued message editing: press Enter or use the confirm button to submit, use Shift+Enter for a new line, and avoid accidental submission while composing with an IME.
- Removed the redundant permission button when an Agent Role is selected, reducing configuration conflicts and interface clutter.
- Fixed HTML attachment paths failing to open correctly on Windows.
- Fixed duplicate borders appearing around the queued message editor.
- Optimized session and file-change data loading and caching to reduce repeated scans and resource usage.
